rationale: C17 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both orders designate a department secretary to exercise enumerated statutory powers of the President, organize those powers in lettered subsections using the repeated formula “authority vested in the President,” eliminate the need for presidential approval or ratification, and preserve existing regulations until superseded. The child expands and adapts that same delegation machinery for the Secretary of the Interior. C13 is a weaker parallel delegation of several specifically cited presidential functions, while C18 shares delegation terminology and an unusually close definition of “functions” but not the child’s compact structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of the Interior is hereby designated and empowered to perform the following-described functions of the President without the approval, ratification, or other action of the President
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of State is authorized and directed to exercise the following-described statutory powers of the President
shared_material.explanation: Both begin with substantially the same operative device: assigning a specified secretary a collection of presidential statutory powers.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The authority vested in the President by section 1 of the act ...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The authority vested in the President by section 901 of the Foreign Service Act of 1946 ...
shared_material.explanation: Both enumerate the delegated powers in lettered subsections built around the same recurring statutory-citation formula.

shared_material.child_excerpt: without the approval, ratification, or other action of the President
shared_material.parent_excerpt: without the necessity of any signature, approval, ratification, or other act of the President
shared_material.explanation: This distinctive cluster of terms directly parallels C17’s provision making delegated action effective without further presidential participation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: regulations prescribed by the President ... shall ... remain in effect until modified or revoked pursuant to the authority conferred by this order
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Existing rules and regulations ... shall remain in effect until superseded by action taken pursuant to this order
shared_material.explanation: Both include a materially similar continuity provision preserving prior regulations while transferring their future administration.
